zh.name: 愚者
zh.meaningUpright: 新的开始，随性，纯真，信念的飞跃，自由精神。
zh.meaningReversed: 鲁莽，犹豫，天真，判断力差，害怕改变。

en.name: The Fool
en.meaningUpright: New beginnings, spontaneity, innocence, a leap of faith, free spirit.
en.meaningReversed: Recklessness, hesitation, naivety, poor judgment, fear of change.

zh.name: 魔术师
zh.meaningUpright: 显化、意志力、足智多谋、技能、专注行动。
zh.meaningReversed: 操控、未开发的天赋、精力涣散、欺骗、幻觉。

en.name: The Magician
en.meaningUpright: Manifestation, willpower, resourcefulness, skill, focused action.
en.meaningReversed: Manipulation, untapped talent, scattered energy, deception, illusion.

zh.name: 女祭司
zh.meaningUpright: 直觉、内在智慧、神秘、潜意识、静止。
zh.meaningReversed: 忽视直觉、秘密、与自我失联、隐藏动机、表面知识。

en.name: The High Priestess
en.meaningUpright: Intuition, inner wisdom, mystery, the subconscious, stillness.
en.meaningReversed: Ignored intuition, secrets, disconnection from self, hidden motives, surface knowledge.

zh.name: 皇后
zh.meaningUpright: 丰饶、滋养、丰产、创造力、感官享受。
zh.meaningReversed: 创意阻塞、令人窒息、自我忽视、依赖、停滞。

en.name: The Empress
en.meaningUpright: Abundance, nurturing, fertility, creativity, sensuality.
en.meaningReversed: Creative block, smothering, self-neglect, dependence, stagnation.

zh.name: 皇帝
zh.meaningUpright: 结构、权威、稳定、领导力、纪律。
zh.meaningReversed: 僵化、控制问题、支配、缺乏纪律、滥用权力。

en.name: The Emperor
en.meaningUpright: Structure, authority, stability, leadership, discipline.
en.meaningReversed: Rigidity, control issues, domination, lack of discipline, abuse of power.

zh.name: 教皇
zh.meaningUpright: 传统、指引、共同价值观、机构、导师指导。
zh.meaningReversed: 反叛、质疑常规、束缚、教条、打破规则。

en.name: The Hierophant
en.meaningUpright: Tradition, guidance, shared values, institutions, mentorship.
en.meaningReversed: Rebellion, questioning convention, constriction, dogma, breaking the rules.

zh.name: 恋人
zh.meaningUpright: 爱情、结合、一致、有意义的选择、和谐。
zh.meaningReversed: 不和、不一致、逃避选择、诱惑、失衡。

en.name: The Lovers
en.meaningUpright: Love, union, alignment, a meaningful choice, harmony.
en.meaningReversed: Disharmony, imbalance, misalignment, temptation, indecision.

zh.name: 战车
zh.meaningUpright: 决心、胜利、意志力、自制力和动力。
zh.meaningReversed: 缺乏方向、攻击性、障碍、力量分散和失控。

en.name: The Chariot
en.meaningUpright: Determination, willpower, victory, control, momentum.
en.meaningReversed: Lack of direction, aggression, obstacles, scattered strength, loss of control.

zh.name: 力量
zh.meaningUpright: 勇气、内在力量、耐心、同情、温和的力量。
zh.meaningReversed: 自我怀疑、原始情绪、急躁、不安全感、强迫。

en.name: Strength
en.meaningUpright: Inner strength, courage, patience, compassion, gentle strength.
en.meaningReversed: Self-doubt, raw emotion, impatience, insecurity, forcing outcomes.

zh.name: 隐士
zh.meaningUpright: 内省、独处、内在指引、智慧、探索。
zh.meaningReversed: 孤立、孤独、退缩、迷失方向、逃避。

en.name: The Hermit
en.meaningUpright: Introspection, solitude, inner guidance, soul-searching, wisdom.
en.meaningReversed: Isolation, loneliness, withdrawal, lost direction, avoidance.

zh.name: 命运之轮
zh.meaningUpright: 改变、循环、命运、转折点、运气。
zh.meaningReversed: 抗拒改变、厄运、重复循环、挫折、执着。

en.name: Wheel of Fortune
en.meaningUpright: Cycles, fate, turning point, luck, change.
en.meaningReversed: Resisting change, bad luck, stuck in a cycle, setbacks, holding on.

zh.name: 正义
zh.meaningUpright: 公平、真相、责任、因果、清晰。
zh.meaningReversed: 不公平、不诚实、逃避责任、偏见、失衡。

en.name: Justice
en.meaningUpright: Fairness, truth, accountability, cause and effect, clarity.
en.meaningReversed: Bias, dishonesty, avoiding accountability, unfairness, imbalance.

zh.name: 倒吊人
zh.meaningUpright: 臣服，新视角，暂停，放下，悬置。
zh.meaningReversed: 拖延，抗拒，殉道，犹豫不决，徒劳的牺牲。

en.name: The Hanged Man
en.meaningUpright: Pause, new perspective, surrender, letting go, suspension.
en.meaningReversed: Stalling, stagnation, martyrdom, indecision, pointless sacrifice.

zh.name: 死神
zh.meaningUpright: 终结、转变、过渡、放下、重生。
zh.meaningReversed: 抗拒终结、停滞、恐惧变化、执着不放、未完全了结。

en.name: Death
en.meaningUpright: Endings, transformation, transition, release, rebirth.
en.meaningReversed: Resisting an ending, stagnation, fear of change, delayed transition, holding on.

zh.name: 节制
zh.meaningUpright: 平衡、适度、耐心、调和、疗愈。
zh.meaningReversed: 过度、失衡、急躁、摩擦、矫枉过正。

en.name: Temperance
en.meaningUpright: Balance, moderation, patience, blending, harmony.
en.meaningReversed: Excess, imbalance, impatience, extremes, lack of harmony.

zh.name: 恶魔
zh.meaningUpright: 执着、诱惑、不健康模式、物质主义、感到束缚。
zh.meaningReversed: 挣脱束缚、重获力量、觉醒、释放、恢复。

en.name: The Devil
en.meaningUpright: Attachment, temptation, unhealthy patterns, materialism, feeling bound.
en.meaningReversed: Breaking free, reclaiming power, awakening, release, recovery.

zh.name: 高塔
zh.meaningUpright: 突然剧变、启示、虚假的崩溃、瓦解、觉醒。
zh.meaningReversed: 避免灾难、恐惧改变、延迟崩溃、抗拒不可避免之事、内在剧变。

en.name: The Tower
en.meaningUpright: Upheaval, revelation, the collapse of falsehood, breakdown, awakening.
en.meaningReversed: Averted disaster, fear of change, delayed collapse, resisting the inevitable, inner upheaval.

zh.name: 星星
zh.meaningUpright: 希望、重生、疗愈、灵感、信念。
zh.meaningReversed: 气馁、失去信念、疏离、自我怀疑、希望暗淡。

en.name: The Star
en.meaningUpright: Hope, renewal, healing, inspiration, faith.
en.meaningReversed: Discouragement, lost faith, disconnection, self-doubt, dimmed hope.

zh.name: 月亮
zh.meaningUpright: 幻象、直觉、不确定、潜意识、梦境。
zh.meaningReversed: 清晰浮现、恐惧释放、真相浮出、困惑消散、自我欺骗终结。

en.name: The Moon
en.meaningUpright: Illusion, intuition, uncertainty, the subconscious, dreams.
en.meaningReversed: Clarity emerging, releasing fear, truth revealed, confusion clearing, self-deception ending.

zh.name: 太阳
zh.meaningUpright: 喜悦、成功、活力、清晰、自信。
zh.meaningReversed: 黯淡的喜悦、暂时的挫折、悲观、倦怠、延迟的成功。

en.name: The Sun
en.meaningUpright: Joy, success, vitality, clarity, confidence.
en.meaningReversed: Dimmed joy, temporary setback, pessimism, burnout, delayed success.

zh.name: 审判
zh.meaningUpright: 觉醒、清算、重生、召唤、自我评估。
zh.meaningReversed: 自我批判、忽视召唤、困于过去、严苛审判、逃避。

en.name: Judgement
en.meaningUpright: Awakening, reckoning, renewal, inner calling, self-assessment.
en.meaningReversed: Self-criticism, ignoring the call, stuck in the past, harsh judgment, avoidance.

zh.name: 世界
zh.meaningUpright: 完成、圆满、完整、成就、整合。
zh.meaningReversed: 未完成、遗留问题、延迟收尾、走捷径、未竟之事。

en.name: The World
en.meaningUpright: Completion, integration, fulfillment, wholeness, achievement.
en.meaningReversed: Incomplete, loose ends, delayed closure, shortcuts taken, unfinished business.

zh.name: 权杖一
zh.meaningUpright: 灵感，新机遇，创造火花，热情，潜力。
zh.meaningReversed: 延误，假启动，缺乏动力，创造力受阻，犹豫。

en.name: Ace of Wands
en.meaningUpright: Inspiration, a new opportunity, a creative spark, passion, potential.
en.meaningReversed: Delay, a false start, lack of drive, creative block, hesitation.

zh.name: 权杖二
zh.meaningUpright: 规划、未来愿景、决策、扩张、掌控世界。
zh.meaningReversed: 对未知的恐惧、安于现状、规划不足、不安、犹豫不决。

en.name: Two of Wands
en.meaningUpright: Planning, a vision of the future, decisions, expansion, command of your world.
en.meaningReversed: Fear of the unknown, playing it safe, lack of planning, unease, indecision.

zh.name: 权杖三
zh.meaningUpright: 进步、扩张、远见、船只入港、势头。
zh.meaningReversed: 延误、计划受阻、目光短浅、挫折、急躁。

en.name: Three of Wands
en.meaningUpright: Expansion, steady progress, long-range vision, ships coming in, momentum building.
en.meaningReversed: Delays, obstacles, frustration, limited outlook, plans on hold.

zh.name: 权杖四
zh.meaningUpright: 庆祝、归家、里程碑、社区、稳定。
zh.meaningReversed: 家庭不稳定、庆祝延期、过渡、缺乏支持、基础动摇。

en.name: Four of Wands
en.meaningUpright: Celebration, a joyful homecoming, a milestone reached, community, stability.
en.meaningReversed: An unstable home, a postponed celebration, transition, lack of support, shaky foundations.

zh.name: 权杖五
zh.meaningUpright: 冲突、竞争、摩擦、自我冲突、精力分散。
zh.meaningReversed: 避免冲突、和解、内心冲突、压力释放、挑选战斗。

en.name: Five of Wands
en.meaningUpright: Conflict, competition, friction, inner conflict, scattered energy.
en.meaningReversed: Conflict resolved, tension eased or avoided, inner conflict easing, pressure released, battles chosen carefully.

zh.name: 权杖六
zh.meaningUpright: 胜利、认可、成功、自信、公众赞誉。
zh.meaningReversed: 私下胜利、失宠、自我怀疑、缺乏认可、自负膨胀。

en.name: Six of Wands
en.meaningUpright: Victory, recognition, public success, confidence rewarded.
en.meaningReversed: Success unacknowledged, recognition withheld, ego trouble, quiet self-doubt.

zh.name: 权杖七
zh.meaningUpright: 防御、坚守立场、坚持不懈、信念、保持优势。
zh.meaningReversed: 不堪重负、退让、精疲力尽、防卫过度、屈服。

en.name: Seven of Wands
en.meaningUpright: Defense, standing your ground, perseverance, holding your advantage, conviction.
en.meaningReversed: Overwhelmed, giving ground, exhaustion, over-defensiveness, giving in.

zh.name: 权杖八
zh.meaningUpright: 迅速行动、势头、消息到来、协调一致、快速进展。
zh.meaningReversed: 延迟、挫败、精力分散、错失时机、放缓。

en.name: Eight of Wands
en.meaningUpright: Speed, momentum, swift developments, messages arriving, events aligning.
en.meaningReversed: Delays, frustration, scattered energy, missed timing, a slowdown.

zh.name: 权杖九
zh.meaningUpright: 韧性，背水一战，坚持，防备，接近目标。
zh.meaningReversed: 倦怠，偏执，最后放弃，僵硬防御，战斗疲劳。

en.name: Nine of Wands
en.meaningUpright: Resilience, one last stand, persistence, guardedness, nearing the goal.
en.meaningReversed: Exhaustion, paranoia, giving up at the end, rigid defenses, battle fatigue.

zh.name: 权杖十
zh.meaningUpright: 负担、超载、责任、承担过多、最后的努力。
zh.meaningReversed: 放手、委派、卸下负担、崩溃、学会说不。

en.name: Ten of Wands
en.meaningUpright: Carrying a heavy load, overload of responsibility, pressure, duty held to the end.
en.meaningReversed: Letting go, delegating, setting the burden down, collapse under the weight, learning to say no.

zh.name: 权杖侍从
zh.meaningUpright: 热情、探索、自由精神、令人兴奋的消息、好奇心。
zh.meaningReversed: 精力分散、仓促开始、无聊、不可靠的消息、焦躁不安。

en.name: Page of Wands
en.meaningUpright: Enthusiasm, exploring new ideas, free-spirited discovery, creative curiosity.
en.meaningReversed: Scattered energy, hasty beginnings, boredom, unreliable news, restlessness.

zh.name: 权杖骑士
zh.meaningUpright: 行动、冒险、热情、大胆追求、魅力。
zh.meaningReversed: 冲动、鲁莽、分散的热情、行动延迟、火爆脾气。

en.name: Knight of Wands
en.meaningUpright: Passion, bold action, adventure, charismatic momentum.
en.meaningReversed: Impulsiveness, recklessness, scattered passion, delayed action, a hot temper.

zh.name: 权杖王后
zh.meaningUpright: 自信、温暖、决心、魅力、独立。
zh.meaningReversed: 不安全感、嫉妒、苛刻、倦怠、信心黯淡。

en.name: Queen of Wands
en.meaningUpright: Radiant confidence, warmth, determination, charisma, independence.
en.meaningReversed: Insecurity, jealousy, a demanding streak, burnout, fading confidence.

zh.name: 权杖国王
zh.meaningUpright: 远见卓识的领导力、大胆、创业精神、掌控火元素、启发灵感。
zh.meaningReversed: 傲慢、暴政、冲动的领导、未实现的愿景、专横。

en.name: King of Wands
en.meaningUpright: Visionary leadership, boldness, entrepreneurial spirit, mastery of fire, inspiration.
en.meaningReversed: Arrogance, tyranny, impulsive leadership, an unrealized vision, domineering.

zh.name: 圣杯一
zh.meaningUpright: 新恋情、情感开端、同情心、满溢的心灵、灵性开启。
zh.meaningReversed: 情感阻塞、空虚感、压抑情感、情感失落、需要自爱。

en.name: Ace of Cups
en.meaningUpright: New love, emotional awakening, compassion, an overflowing heart, a spiritual opening.
en.meaningReversed: Blocked emotions, emptiness, withheld feelings, emotional loss, a need for self-love.

zh.name: 圣杯二
zh.meaningUpright: 伴侣关系、相互吸引、连接、和谐、平等者的结合。
zh.meaningReversed: 失衡、断裂的连接、紧张、沟通不良、需要自我陪伴。

en.name: Two of Cups
en.meaningUpright: Mutual attraction, true partnership, connection, harmony, a union of equals.
en.meaningReversed: Imbalance, a broken connection, tension, poor communication, needing your own company.

zh.name: 圣杯三
zh.meaningUpright: 庆祝、友谊、社群、共享喜悦、创意协作。
zh.meaningReversed: 过度放纵、第三方干涉、与朋友疏离、流言蜚语、过度。

en.name: Three of Cups
en.meaningUpright: Celebration, friendship, community, shared joy, creative collaboration.
en.meaningReversed: Gossip, third-party strain, overindulgence, celebration called off.

zh.name: 圣杯四
zh.meaningUpright: 冷漠、沉思、疏离、错失机会、重新评估。
zh.meaningReversed: 重燃兴趣、接受提议、走出退缩、新动力、开放心态。

en.name: Four of Cups
en.meaningUpright: Apathy, withdrawal into thought, an offer overlooked, reassessing what matters.
en.meaningReversed: Renewed interest, accepting the offer, emerging from withdrawal, new motivation, openness.

zh.name: 圣杯五
zh.meaningUpright: 失落、悲伤、遗憾、专注于失去、失望。
zh.meaningReversed: 接受、前行、宽恕、看见剩余、疗愈。

en.name: Five of Cups
en.meaningUpright: Loss, grief, regret, focus on what has spilled, disappointment.
en.meaningReversed: Acceptance, grief easing, moving on, seeing what remains, healing.

zh.name: 圣杯六
zh.meaningUpright: 怀旧、童年、纯真、重逢、简单的善意。
zh.meaningReversed: 困于过去、美化记忆、离开家园、成长、释放旧纽带。

en.name: Six of Cups
en.meaningUpright: Nostalgia, childhood warmth, innocence, reunion, simple generosity.
en.meaningReversed: Stuck in the past, idealized memories, leaving home, growth, releasing old ties.

zh.name: 圣杯七
zh.meaningUpright: 选择、幻想、幻觉、一厢情愿、选项。
zh.meaningReversed: 清晰、已做决定、看穿幻象、迷茫消散、现实。

en.name: Seven of Cups
en.meaningUpright: Choices, fantasy, illusion, wishful thinking, too many options.
en.meaningReversed: Clarity, a decision made, seeing through illusion, confusion clearing, reality restored.

zh.name: 圣杯八
zh.meaningUpright: 离开，寻求更深的意义，抛下过去，幻灭，追寻。
zh.meaningReversed: 害怕离开，回归，逃避，停留过久，未完成的离开。

en.name: Eight of Cups
en.meaningUpright: Walking away from what no longer fulfills, seeking deeper meaning, an inner call to leave.
en.meaningReversed: Fear of leaving, returning, avoidance, staying too long, an unfinished departure.

zh.name: 圣杯九
zh.meaningUpright: 愿望实现，知足，满意，愉快，感恩。
zh.meaningReversed: 表面幸福，贪婪，未实现的愿望，自满，内心匮乏。

en.name: Nine of Cups
en.meaningUpright: Contentment, the wish fulfilled, satisfaction, pleasure, gratitude.
en.meaningReversed: The wish unfulfilled, smugness, overindulgence, pleasure that doesn't satisfy.

zh.name: 圣杯十
zh.meaningUpright: 持久幸福、家庭和睦、情感圆满、爱情实现、归属感。
zh.meaningReversed: 家庭不和、和谐破裂、不切实际的理想、家中疏离、关系紧张。

en.name: Ten of Cups
en.meaningUpright: Family harmony, emotional fulfillment, love fulfilled, belonging, lasting joy.
en.meaningReversed: Family discord, broken harmony, unrealistic ideals, distance at home, relationship strain.

zh.name: 圣杯侍从
zh.meaningUpright: 情感开放，创意讯息，直觉萌芽，敏感，甜蜜惊喜。
zh.meaningReversed: 情感不成熟，情绪化，创造力受阻，逃避现实，过度敏感。

en.name: Page of Cups
en.meaningUpright: Emotional openness, a creative message, sprouting intuition, sensitivity, a sweet surprise.
en.meaningReversed: Emotional immaturity, moodiness, blocked creativity, escaping reality, oversensitivity.

zh.name: 圣杯骑士
zh.meaningUpright: 浪漫、魅力、邀请、跟随内心、理想主义。
zh.meaningReversed: 不切实际的承诺、情绪化、幻灭、奉承、感情用事而犯错。

en.name: Knight of Cups
en.meaningUpright: Romance, following the heart, idealism in motion, an invitation, charm.
en.meaningReversed: Unrealistic promises, moodiness, disillusionment, flattery, letting feelings lead you astray.

zh.name: 圣杯王后
zh.meaningUpright: 同理心、情感深度、直觉、滋养陪伴、共情能力。
zh.meaningReversed: 情感泛滥、共依赖、殉道者心态、边界消融、情感操控。

en.name: Queen of Cups
en.meaningUpright: Deep compassion, emotional maturity, intuitive empathy, calm support for others.
en.meaningReversed: Emotional flooding, codependence, a martyr complex, boundaries dissolving, emotional manipulation.

zh.name: 圣杯国王
zh.meaningUpright: 情绪掌控、冷静权威、外交手腕、心脑平衡、明智建议。
zh.meaningReversed: 压抑情感、冷漠、操控、权力中情绪化、情绪波动。

en.name: King of Cups
en.meaningUpright: Emotional mastery, composure, diplomacy, wise counsel, a balanced heart.
en.meaningReversed: Feelings suppressed, coldness, manipulation, moodiness in power, emotional volatility.

zh.name: 宝剑一
zh.meaningUpright: 清晰、突破、真相、新想法、思维敏锐。
zh.meaningReversed: 困惑、判断蒙蔽、误用才智、尖刻言语、虚假清晰。

en.name: Ace of Swords
en.meaningUpright: Mental clarity, breakthrough insight, truth cutting through, a sharp new idea.
en.meaningReversed: Confusion, clouded judgment, misused intellect, harsh words, false clarity.

zh.name: 宝剑二
zh.meaningUpright: 僵局、艰难选择、回避、情感阻塞、休战。
zh.meaningReversed: 被迫抉择、信息揭示、打破僵局、焦虑、否认解除。

en.name: Two of Swords
en.meaningUpright: A stalemate, a difficult choice, avoidance, emotional blockage, a truce.
en.meaningReversed: A forced decision, information revealed, the deadlock broken, anxiety, denial lifting.

zh.name: 宝剑三
zh.meaningUpright: 心碎、痛苦的真相、悲伤、哀伤、分离。
zh.meaningReversed: 疗愈心碎、宽恕、释放痛苦、恢复、旧伤重现。

en.name: Three of Swords
en.meaningUpright: Heartbreak, a painful truth, sorrow, grief, separation.
en.meaningReversed: Healing heartbreak, forgiveness, releasing pain, recovery, old wounds resurfacing.

zh.name: 宝剑四
zh.meaningUpright: 休息、恢复、隐退、静止、充电。
zh.meaningReversed: 倦怠、不安、被迫休息、重返行动、忽视疲惫。

en.name: Four of Swords
en.meaningUpright: Rest, recovery, contemplative pause, mental recharge, stillness after strain.
en.meaningReversed: Burnout, restlessness, a forced pause, returning to action too soon, fatigue ignored.

zh.name: 宝剑五
zh.meaningUpright: 空洞的胜利、冲突、不惜代价的胜利、不和、自私自利。
zh.meaningReversed: 和解、弥补过错、释怀怨恨、纠缠的怨恨、学到教训。

en.name: Five of Swords
en.meaningUpright: A victory that costs too much, conflict, self-interest winning, strife lingering.
en.meaningReversed: Reconciliation, making amends, releasing resentment, lingering resentment, learning the lesson.

zh.name: 宝剑六
zh.meaningUpright: 过渡，继续前行，平静水域，航程，逐渐愈合。
zh.meaningReversed: 抗拒过渡，未了之事，颠簸航程，重回困扰，背负包袱。

en.name: Six of Swords
en.meaningUpright: Transition to calmer waters, moving on, a passage out of trouble, gradual healing.
en.meaningReversed: Resistance to transition, unfinished business, a rough passage, trouble returning, carrying baggage.

zh.name: 宝剑七
zh.meaningUpright: 欺骗、策略、独自行动、侥幸脱身、狡猾。
zh.meaningReversed: 坦白、良心、曝光、坦白交代、自欺欺人被发现。

en.name: Seven of Swords
en.meaningUpright: Deception, strategy, acting alone, getting away with it, cunning.
en.meaningReversed: Confession, conscience, exposure, coming clean, self-deceit unmasked.

zh.name: 宝剑八
zh.meaningUpright: 感觉被困、自我限制、受害者心态、精神牢笼、瘫痪无力。
zh.meaningReversed: 解放、新视角、自我赋权、摘下眼罩、承担责任。

en.name: Eight of Swords
en.meaningUpright: Feeling trapped, self-imposed limits, a victim mindset, a mental prison, helplessness.
en.meaningReversed: Liberation, a new perspective, self-empowerment, the blindfold lifted, taking responsibility.

zh.name: 宝剑九
zh.meaningUpright: 焦虑、失眠、担忧、恐惧、精神痛苦。
zh.meaningReversed: 缓解焦虑、面对恐惧、寻求帮助、恢复视角、走出绝望。

en.name: Nine of Swords
en.meaningUpright: Anxiety, insomnia, worry, fear, mental anguish.
en.meaningReversed: Anxiety easing, facing fear, seeking help, regaining perspective, emerging from despair.

zh.name: 宝剑十
zh.meaningUpright: 痛苦的结局，跌入谷底，背叛，崩溃，最坏已经过去。
zh.meaningReversed: 恢复，重新崛起，在结局中幸存，旧伤愈合，拒绝最终教训。

en.name: Ten of Swords
en.meaningUpright: A painful ending, rock bottom, betrayal, collapse, the worst is over.
en.meaningReversed: Recovery, rising again, surviving the ending, old wounds healing, refusing the final lesson.

zh.name: 宝剑侍从
zh.meaningUpright: 好奇心、警惕、新想法、精神能量、追求真相。
zh.meaningReversed: 流言蜚语、轻率言语、思绪散乱、窥探、空谈。

en.name: Page of Swords
en.meaningUpright: Curiosity, vigilance, new ideas, mental energy, seeking truth.
en.meaningReversed: Gossip, hasty words, scattered thinking, prying, empty talk.

zh.name: 宝剑骑士
zh.meaningUpright: 果断行动、雄心壮志、直言不讳、一往无前、求知欲。
zh.meaningReversed: 鲁莽、攻击性、忽视细节、冲刺耗尽、言语攻击。

en.name: Knight of Swords
en.meaningUpright: Decisive action, ambition, blunt speech, charging ahead, a thirst for knowledge.
en.meaningReversed: Recklessness, aggression, ignoring details, burning out mid-sprint, verbal attacks.

zh.name: 宝剑王后
zh.meaningUpright: 清晰的判断、独立自主、坦诚沟通、设立界限、经验智慧。
zh.meaningReversed: 冷漠、怨恨、苛刻批评、孤立、愤世嫉俗。

en.name: Queen of Swords
en.meaningUpright: Clear judgment, independence, honest communication, firm boundaries, wisdom from experience.
en.meaningReversed: Coldness, bitterness, harsh judgment, isolation, cynicism.

zh.name: 宝剑国王
zh.meaningUpright: 智慧权威，真相，公正判断，策略，伦理清晰。
zh.meaningReversed: 滥用智慧，冷酷无情，操纵，僵化逻辑，不公判断。

en.name: King of Swords
en.meaningUpright: Intellectual authority, ethical clarity, objective judgment, strategic mastery.
en.meaningReversed: Abuse of intellect, ruthlessness, manipulation, rigid logic, unfair judgment.

zh.name: 星币一
zh.meaningUpright: 新机遇、繁荣、显化、坚实基础、物质馈赠。
zh.meaningReversed: 错失良机、根基不稳、匮乏思维、回报延迟、糟糕投资。

en.name: Ace of Pentacles
en.meaningUpright: A new material opportunity, prosperity seeded, a solid start, manifestation in the real world.
en.meaningReversed: A missed opportunity, shaky foundations, a scarcity mindset, delayed returns, a poor investment.

zh.name: 星币二
zh.meaningUpright: 兼顾多项优先事项，适应力，动态平衡，灵活性，应对变化。
zh.meaningReversed: 过度承诺，顾此失彼，混乱无序，财务紧张，不堪重负。

en.name: Two of Pentacles
en.meaningUpright: Juggling priorities, adaptability, dynamic balance, flexibility, handling change.
en.meaningReversed: Overcommitted, dropping the ball, disorder, financial strain, overwhelmed.

zh.name: 星币三
zh.meaningUpright: 团队合作、精湛技艺、技能获认可、协作、共同建设。
zh.meaningReversed: 团队合作不佳、平庸、缺乏认可、目标不一致、独自工作。

en.name: Three of Pentacles
en.meaningUpright: Skilled collaboration, craftsmanship honored, building together, contribution recognized.
en.meaningReversed: Poor coordination, skills unvalued, discord among collaborators, working alone.

zh.name: 星币四
zh.meaningUpright: 安全，紧握，掌控，储蓄，占有欲。
zh.meaningReversed: 放手，慷慨，放松掌控，财务释放，消费。

en.name: Four of Pentacles
en.meaningUpright: Security held tightly, resources controlled, saving, possessiveness.
en.meaningReversed: Letting go, generosity, releasing control, financial release, spending.

zh.name: 星币五
zh.meaningUpright: 艰难、匮乏、被冷落、财务损失、孤立。
zh.meaningReversed: 恢复、接受帮助、困境结束、找到庇护、重燃希望。

en.name: Five of Pentacles
en.meaningUpright: Hardship, scarcity, being left out in the cold, financial loss, isolation.
en.meaningReversed: Help within reach and accepted, hardship easing, shelter and recovery.

zh.name: 星币六
zh.meaningUpright: 慷慨、给予与接受、支持、公平、慈善。
zh.meaningReversed: 附带条件、权力失衡、单方面付出、债务、忽视自我地付出。

en.name: Six of Pentacles
en.meaningUpright: Generosity flowing, fair exchange, giving and receiving in balance, support offered.
en.meaningReversed: Strings attached, power imbalance, one-sided giving, debt, giving past your own needs.

zh.name: 星币七
zh.meaningUpright: 耐心、评估、长远眼光、缓慢成长、等待收获。
zh.meaningReversed: 不耐烦、徒劳无功、回报不佳、提早放弃、努力错位。

en.name: Seven of Pentacles
en.meaningUpright: Patience, assessment, long-term vision, slow growth, waiting for the harvest.
en.meaningReversed: Impatience, wasted effort, poor returns, giving up early, misplaced effort.

zh.name: 星币八
zh.meaningUpright: 勤奋、技能培养、工匠精神、专注投入、通过反复练习达到精通。
zh.meaningReversed: 完美主义、枯燥乏味、偷工减料、努力方向错误、过度劳累导致倦怠。

en.name: Eight of Pentacles
en.meaningUpright: Diligence, skill-building, craftsmanship, focused dedication, mastery through repetition.
en.meaningReversed: Perfectionism, drudgery, cutting corners, misplaced effort, burnout from overwork.

zh.name: 星币九
zh.meaningUpright: 自给自足，应得的奢华，独立，精致，享受成功。
zh.meaningReversed: 过度依赖，虚假的成功，过度工作而无享受，财务不安全，自我价值与财富挂钩。

en.name: Nine of Pentacles
en.meaningUpright: Self-sufficiency, earned luxury, independence, refinement, enjoying success.
en.meaningReversed: Over-dependence, false success, working without enjoyment, financial insecurity, self-worth tied to wealth.

zh.name: 星币十
zh.meaningUpright: 遗产、持久财富、家庭安定、继承、长期根基。
zh.meaningReversed: 家庭资源纷争、不稳定的根基、短视思维、丧失继承、缺乏归属感的财富。

en.name: Ten of Pentacles
en.meaningUpright: Legacy, lasting wealth, family stability, inheritance, long-term foundations.
en.meaningReversed: Family friction over resources, insecure foundations, short-term thinking, lost inheritance, wealth without belonging.

zh.name: 星币侍从
zh.meaningUpright: 好学、新实用技能、学习机会、务实抱负、勤勉开端。
zh.meaningReversed: 拖延、缺乏进展、空想不行动、短暂专注、错失课程。

en.name: Page of Pentacles
en.meaningUpright: Eagerness to learn, a new practical skill, a learning opportunity, grounded ambition, a diligent beginning.
en.meaningReversed: Procrastination, lack of progress, dreams without action, short-lived focus, a missed chance to learn.

zh.name: 星币骑士
zh.meaningUpright: 可靠、按部就班的进展、勤奋工作、耐心、坚持例行公事。
zh.meaningReversed: 停滞、无聊、固执、工作狂、墨守成规。

en.name: Knight of Pentacles
en.meaningUpright: Reliable, methodical progress, diligence, patience, sticking to routine.
en.meaningReversed: Stagnation, boredom, stubbornness, workaholism, a rigid routine.

zh.name: 星币王后
zh.meaningUpright: 滋养的务实、足智多谋、温暖与安全感、职场供养者、踏实的关怀。
zh.meaningReversed: 自我忽视、工作与家庭失衡、过度提供令人窒息、财务依赖、耗尽的照顾者。

en.name: Queen of Pentacles
en.meaningUpright: Practical nurturing, resourcefulness, warmth and security, a provider at work, grounded care.
en.meaningReversed: Self-neglect, work-home imbalance, smothering over-giving, financial dependence, a depleted caregiver.

zh.name: 星币国王
zh.meaningUpright: 物质掌控，丰盛，稳健领导，商业敏锐，可靠供养者。
zh.meaningReversed: 贪婪，物质主义，对资源的刻板控制，地位痴迷，安逸的腐化。

en.name: King of Pentacles
en.meaningUpright: Material mastery, prosperity, steady leadership, business acumen, a reliable provider.
en.meaningReversed: Greed, materialism, rigid control of resources, status obsession, softened by comfort.
